ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies posted modest gains across the board, with BTC hovering near $83,844 and ETH up over 2%. Positive price action coincides with news of Bitcoin holding above $84k despite ETF outflows and ongoing regulatory developments in Europe. New token listings on Delta India add fresh liquidity but the market remains attentive to technical and regulatory catalysts.
